podcast.body: This 1980 album, featuring Blondie's chart-topping cover of "The Tide Is High," received strong criticism from Rolling Stone magazine but garnered considerable affection from Gen Xers. "From the 1980 album, Auto American, much trashed by Rolling Stone magazine, but much beloved by Gen Xers."

podcast.body: This album was recorded in 1980 with producer Mike Chapman, building on the band's prior success with "Call Me." Like Talking Heads with "Remain in Light," Blondie explored sounds from beyond American borders, showcasing a wide array of genre experiments including reggae and early hip-hop. "Blondie in 1980 were building on their success with Colmy as they recorded their next album, Auto American, with producer Mike Chapman."
